summary: Nora can read an Instagram link someone pastes, or an account by its handle: a profile, a story, or a whole post or reel.
details: Paste a profile link or type someone's handle and she reads that account's profile, whoever it belongs to. The handle is looked up exactly: if no account has that username she says so rather than guessing a similar one.

Paste a post or reel link and she gets the whole post: who posted it, when, the caption, and every photo or video in order (a carousel keeps its order, and a video says how long it is). To see what a photo or clip actually shows she then looks at the ones that matter.

A story link or handle is opened only for someone who is in the conversation where it was asked and whom the operator has listed. A story link to anyone else, a stranger or a friend from another group included, is refused and never opened, with the same answer either way, so it gives away nothing about who is in her other groups. If a friend has two accounts, a link to one of them reads that one, while asking for the friend by name still gets "I can't tell which".
"What's on her story" with a profile link reads that account's story, and a story-ring link (one with no frame id) reads the current story. Highlight links are not read.

Stories, posts and reels are opened only when a person asks. In a reminder, a proactive message or a background pass she refuses before anything is looked up. Profiles stay readable everywhere, as before.

A link that is not a real Instagram link (another site, a lookalike address, a mangled path) is refused without being sent anywhere. Links are rebuilt from their checked parts, so tracking junk and ids in a link never go further.
limitations: Someone's list of posts or reels still cannot be read: there is no way to fetch it yet.
A post link whose code is longer than 11 characters cannot be read yet (the bridge has no way to decode it), and she says so.
Off by default, with the rest of the Instagram tools. It needs the Instagram bridge running; until then she says Instagram isn't set up.
